title: What BOXABL walls are made of
transcript: this is actually where the process starts where we actually assemble the panels so we are steel concrete and insulation material compressed together with about 250,000 lb of pressure wow and you can imagine if you want to stay hot uh you're living in a thermos and if you want to stay cool you're living in an Igloo cooler that's the best way to think of BOXABL in terms of its thermal efficiency
